# Bodka Core / بودكا كور

Canonical repository: https://github.com/aboodksa4011/Bodka-Core
Version: 0.8.0
Platform: Windows (Win32)
Type: Discord customization and extension platform

Bodka Core is a Windows project for customizing and extending the Discord desktop experience. It includes plugin management, themes, Discord string customization, settings, diagnostics, and developer-oriented tools.

Documented v0.8.0 statistics:
- Discord strings indexed: 8,900
- Total plugins/add-ons: 217
- Working plugins/add-ons: 187
- Remaining non-working/incompatible/disabled/unavailable: 30
- Working rate from these counts: about 86.2%

Primary documentation:
- README.md
- BODKA_CORE_INFO.md
- دليل الاستخدام بودكا كور

Installer:
- BodkaCoreInstaller.exe

Bodka Core is unofficial and is not presented as affiliated with or endorsed by Discord.
